skill.name: researching-with-deepwiki
skill.description: Research remote GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket repositories through the DeepWiki MCP server. The skill helps answer architecture, implementation, and contribution questions about unfamiliar codebases.
skill.summary: Use DeepWiki MCP to explore repository architecture, features, and contribution paths.
skill.author: Asmayaseen

security_audit.summary: Most external command detections are false positives caused by Markdown code fences and inline examples. The real risks are third-party MCP network use and private repository data exposure through the Devin.ai endpoint. No prompt injection attempt was found in the reviewed skill text.

remediation.issue: External DeepWiki and Devin.ai services receive repository queries.
remediation.suggestion: Add a privacy note that users need approval before sending private repository data to third-party MCP services.

remediation.issue: Private repository setup requires an API key in user settings.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to keep tokens out of committed settings files and rotate keys if exposed.

remediation.issue: Remote MCP endpoints are hardcoded in setup instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Document how users can verify official endpoint URLs before configuring the MCP server.

content.value_statement: Understanding an unfamiliar repository can take hours of manual navigation. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to query DeepWiki for architecture and implementation answers.
actual_capabilities: Shows how to configure the public DeepWiki MCP server in Claude Code.
Provides an authenticated Devin.ai endpoint pattern for private repository research.
Supplies prompt examples for architecture, feature, and directory structure questions.
Explains when DeepWiki is useful and when local file tools are better.
Lists supported repository URL formats for GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket.
Includes a verification script that checks for a configured DeepWiki MCP server.
limitations: Requires MCP server configuration before full use.
Public endpoint usage may be rate limited.
Private repository use requires a Devin.ai API key and data sharing approval.
Cached analysis may not reflect the newest commits.

use_cases.title: New Maintainer Onboarding
use_cases.description: Map an unfamiliar repository before reviewing issues or pull requests.

use_cases.title: Integration Debugging
use_cases.description: Find how a dependency implements a feature that affects your application.

use_cases.title: Contribution Planning
use_cases.description: Study project structure, tests, and contribution workflows before proposing a change.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize a Repository
prompt_templates.prompt: Use DeepWiki to summarize github.com/owner/repo. Cover purpose, main modules, and common entry points.

prompt_templates.title: Explain a Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Use DeepWiki to explain how authentication works in github.com/owner/repo. Include key modules and request flow.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Implementations
prompt_templates.prompt: Use DeepWiki to compare how github.com/team/project-a and github.com/team/project-b solve caching. Focus on tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Contribution
prompt_templates.prompt: Use DeepWiki to prepare a contribution plan for github.com/owner/repo. Include tests, ownership areas, and likely review concerns.

output_examples.output: A concise architecture summary with major packages, routing flow, build pipeline, and areas worth reading next.

output_examples.input: How does authentication work in github.com/better-auth/better-auth?
output_examples.output: A feature walkthrough naming core modules, request flow, extension points, and test areas to inspect.

output_examples.input: Compare cache invalidation in two data fetching libraries.
output_examples.output: A side-by-side explanation of strategies, tradeoffs, and design ideas to reuse.

best_practices: Ask specific questions about one feature, path, or workflow at a time.
Use public repositories unless private data sharing has clear approval.
Verify important answers against source files before making production changes.
anti_patterns: Do not use DeepWiki for local workspace files that Read, Glob, or Grep can inspect.
Do not send private repository details to third-party services without approval.
Do not use broad prompts when a targeted architecture or feature question is possible.

faq.question: Does this skill read local files?
faq.answer: No. The skill is intended for remote repository research through DeepWiki. Use local file tools for your current workspace.

faq.question: Which repository hosts are supported?
faq.answer: The skill lists GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket URL formats.

faq.question: Can it research private repositories?
faq.answer: Yes, but private repository use requires Devin.ai authentication and permission to share data with that service.

faq.question: Does it replace official API documentation?
faq.answer: No. It is for repository analysis. Use library documentation tools for API reference questions.

faq.question: What should I ask DeepWiki?
faq.answer: Ask specific questions about architecture, features, paths, tests, or contribution workflows.

faq.question: Are results always current?
faq.answer: No. Cached analysis may lag behind the latest commits.
